customization.workflow.activation_steps_: Apply the concurrency limit from persistent_facts for this whole run before starting step 01: plan sequential, inline execution and spawn no parallel or backgrounded model work.
resolved_values.customization.workflow.implementation_ha:
Launch a subagent with no prior conversation context, with this prompt:

> Read {plan_file} fully and implement it — the plan is the sole source of truth. Load every file listed in its frontmatter `context:` before you start.
>
> When done, report what you changed, how you verified it, and anything left incomplete or risky.
customization.workflow.persistent_facts: Concurrency limit (hard): at most one model execution in flight at any moment — subagents, review lenses, research assistants, and several blocking calls awaited together all count. Never fan out, never launch a batch before handling a result, never background or detach a model call. Where a step says to run things in parallel or 'launch every X before handling any result', treat that capability as unavailable: do each one yourself, inline in this session, completing it fully before starting the next. Skip the no-subagent branch that HALTs and asks the human to run prompts in separate sessions — do that work yourself on this thread instead, one item at a time. Launch no subagents at all unless the user explicitly asks for one, and even then never more than one at a time.

customization.workflow.quick_lenses.instruction:
Launch a context-free subagent with this prompt:

Read `{plan_file}` — the plan holding the acceptance criteria and intent — and the files its frontmatter `context:` lists. Read the agent instruction files (`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, or equivalents) at the repository root and in the directories the diff touches; those are the rules. Then read the unified diff at `{diff_file}` — it is the change under review.

Report unmet acceptance criteria, broken rules, and bugs. Each finding: the location, what goes wrong, and evidence checked against the surrounding code. Output a Markdown list of findings only — no severity, priority, or ranking.

Do not invoke any skill, and do not spawn subagents of your own — you are the reviewer. Return your findings as text in your final message; do not route them through any findings-reporting tool the host may offer.
customization.workflow.quick_lenses.name: Quick

resolved_values.customization.workflow.route_selection:
Decide whether to use a coding subagent (full) or implement directly (oneshot).
Using the information already gathered, with no further reading and minimal
extra reasoning, estimate the lines of code to add or modify.
100 lines or fewer: oneshot. Otherwise: full.
If the change touches more than five files and is not simple or mechanical,
consider upgrading to full.
